page.overview:
What is Attack on a Colicoid nest?

By 252 BBY, hueches attacked a Colicoid nest which included its queen, Jinnix, and his drone-mate. During the attack, the drone-mate failed to protect the queen and afterward listed to Jinnix the reasons for why they had failed. Seeing the reasons as excuses for their failure, Jinnix ripped off the drone-mate's head and ate their ganglia. Sometime later, when Jinnix was a Storm in the Nihil marauder organization, he informed his Strike Towl of the attack on his nest by hueches and his response to his drone-mates attempts to explain their failure to protect the queen when Towl made an excuse for not following an order.

The attack on a Colicoid nest was mentioned in flashbacks in The High Republic: Tempest Runner, a 2021 audio drama written by Cavan Scott and published as a part of the Star Wars: The High Republic multimedia project's Phase I.
